text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Everybody at the castle used to say I was the very best, which made me increasingly fond of keep-ups.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I see. So the secret to your strength is the leg training you've been perfecting since childhood?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You know, reminiscing about that has got me longing for a good old kick-about. ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I know! Why don't we do it together? Let's see who can keep the ball up the longest!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Go! Hup! Ahaha! It's been such a long time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (But my body doesn't feel the same as before… I can't find my center… My body feels… heavy…)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff… Ah, I let the ball fall first.. Looks like that was, uhhh… 134 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And I managed 136 minutes… How close! Although, I used to be able to keep the ball up for five hours straight… Hm. It's certainly a task to maintain both stamina and concentration…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um, I'd like another shot at beating you sometime! I'll show you what I can do with some practice…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! ♪ I'm ready whenever you are! I'd better practice and trim up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, after some serious training, Fine Motion works herself back to her original weight.
